deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary rollout started for service/runtime in prod-us-west. tag=v2.8.7-canary commit=ab3c9f2 slice=5% initiator=@release-mgr-anna
release-mgr-anna: Copy — monitoring on watch. @sahil @carol can you standby for smoke?
sahil: On it. kicking off smoke + perf probes. will post quick snapshot.
deploy-bot: Canary at 5% — healthchecks: passing. p50=82ms p95=210ms error_rate=0.12%
mike: Noticing a small blip of 500s from one replica, sample trace_id=3f9a. attaching snippet: ```ERROR runtime: tokenizer NullPointer at Tokenizer.java:243```
carol: Reproduced with long prompt seed. tokenizer cache warm-up race suspected. working on a quick patch.
jess: If it's cache warm-up maybe fallback path triggers for long inputs, can we revert fallback on canary while patch lands?
release-mgr-anna: Hold at 5% until root cause confirmed. no further ramp.
deploy-bot: Canary paused by release-mgr-anna — traffic maintained at 5% — snapshot saved as `v2.8.7-canary-snapshot-3067890123`
carol: Patch ready: PR #8421 `fix/tokenizer-cache-warmup`. Changes minimal, adds lock around cache init and a micro-benchmark.
sahil: Running PR in staging now. perf looks stable, 500s gone in staging traces.
release-mgr-anna: Ok to hotfix the canary slice with patch. @deploy-bot apply when ready.
deploy-bot: Applying hotfix tag `v2.8.7-canary+hf1` to current canary slice — new commit bd4e9c0.
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% — healthchecks passing, 500s returned to baseline, p95 improved ~12ms
mike: Confirmed p95 drop and no regressions in gen quality on my cursory checks. continuing to monitor.
deploy-bot: Canary ramping to 25% per ramp policy (25% -> 50% -> hold)
oncall-bot: Alert suppression applied for known tokenizer 500s for the rollout window (suppress_id=sup-3067890123)
jess: Running regression eval against curated prompt set — no generation degradation seen.
release-mgr-anna: Metrics look green across errors/latency/quality. Proceeding to 50% and a 10m hold.
deploy-bot: Canary at 50% — smoke hold started (10m)
sahil: 10m hold complete. metrics stable: error_rate=0.03% p95=198ms, infra healthy. recommending promotion.
release-mgr-anna: Promote to stable. Create release tag `v2.8.7` and pin on prod clusters. @deploy-bot please proceed with gradual waves.
deploy-bot: Promotion initiated — creating release tag `v2.8.7` -> rolling to 100% via waves (wave-size=region).
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (us-west-1) complete 
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (us-east-1) complete 
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: service/runtime now at `v2.8.7` in prod (100% traffic) :white_check_mark:
release-mgr-anna: Tag `v2.8.7` pinned in release registry. Release notes: "Fix tokenizer cache warm-up race; minor latency improvements; hotfix applied during canary"
mike: I'll draft a short postmortem for the transient 500s we saw in the first canary wave and link logs/traces.
carol: PR #8421 merged and cherry-picked to release branch. Thanks for rapid reviews.
release-mgr-anna: Great work, team :tada: Please add any followups to the release ticket.
deploy-bot: Release closed. changelog entry created at https://internal/release/3067890123"
